status: generic transport ready on committed source; no external request dispatched
implemented_controls: the request URL and HTTPS authority are exact constants and are rechecked before connection construction
the expected URL, filename, size and wheel digest must appear exactly once in the retained publisher record whose complete-file digest is pinned
one GET is issued with identity encoding through http.client, which provides no automatic redirect or retry behavior
only status 200 with one exact Content-Length and no Content-Range or Transfer-Encoding may reach body reading
a declared body larger than the wheel-only allowance stops before body read; a protocol body overrun is capped at that allowance
receipt and body outputs are create-only and must resolve to different paths
received bytes are hashed incrementally; the retained file is flushed, fsynced and independently re-read and hashed
wrong digest, truncation, interruption, malformed headers, output collisions and retained-file verification failures remain invalid with the available prefix retained
the receipt separates publisher-record digest, expected wheel digest, received-stream digest and retained-file digest
the receipt counts the observed application response and bytes read while leaving protocol overhead and unread response bytes unknown
